evidence_boundary: Constructs the monitored control stack and memory buffer, installs the shared vtable, pushes the initial target, stores input/binding bank at +0x16c and configuration at +0x174, and initializes repeat/button/record/playback state; released ABI has three stack arguments after this and no retained reverse-look-Y constructor argument
Calls the shared destructor, conditionally frees this when deleting flag bit 0 is set, and returns this
Stores current system time in interactive sections but stores 0.0 while the released non-interactive flag is set; retained source always stores current time
Acts only on a flag change and, outside attract mode, converts last-input time to elapsed/remaining form on both entry and exit before storing the new non-interactive state

Enables inactivity quit for playable-demo mode or the released -e3 flag, rejects non-interactive or nonpositive timeout state, and returns true only when elapsed milliseconds are strictly greater than the configured timeout
Sets recording and opens the controller memory buffer for writing with mode 0x11; retained source calls InitFromMem
Sets playback and initializes the memory buffer from the named file with released arguments 0x11, 1, 0
Closes an active record/playback buffer, unregisters and frees every monitored control-stack reader, clears the stack, and destroys the memory buffer
Copies three current virtual-button words to their old words, clears the current words, and dispatches virtual DoMappings at slot 15

Scans 47 released 32-byte action rows with two 12-byte binding banks, performs playback/repeat/push-type dispatch across joystick, keyboard, mouse axes/buttons/transitions/wheel, emits the dual-Shift frontend cheat, and records three virtual-button words last; retained source has only static configuration rows and push types 0..9

Resolves six negative analogue input codes through virtual slots, applies an exact inclusive +/-0.15 deadzone and 1/0.85 remap, and maps nonnegative held inputs to 1.0 or 0.0; retained source exposes four cached axes and a 0.36 deadzone
Returns the current monitored control-stack head target; the empty-stack path has no supported target and callers are expected to preserve the stack invariant

Sets one of three virtual-button words, refreshes inactivity except during zero mouse recenter suppression, routes action IDs below 16 to frontend target or CGame, and gates ordinary actions through reconnect and pause-controllability checks
Allocates a monitored active-reader cell, registers it with the target deletion monitor, and pushes it at the controller-stack head
Pops, unregisters, destroys, and frees the head active reader and logs fatal diagnostics for an initially empty or newly emptied stack
Ignores nonzero requests outside GAME_STATE_PLAYING, permits zero to stop vibration, and sends requested amplitude only when the selected career vibration option is enabled
Single unconditional jump to CController::~CController, used by derived deletion and unwind paths
